gate_round4_flag.bound_derivation: where the window finds a least it does not read, the bound is exact geometry: the share of the sub-cell inside that least's half-plane, summed over the pixel's sub-cells (each at most one sub-cell). A least the window cannot resolve (between two of its samples, a spacing s = h/16 apart) lies at most K s^2 / 8 below the samples' interpolation, K the sign function's curvature along the ray: for the helix near its zero level (the exact distance from the centreline less the filament's radius) K <= 1/r + kappa/(1 - kappa r) = 15.4 /mm on the coil (r = 80 um, kappa = 2.37 /mm) and 15.5 /mm on coil2 (kappa = 2.40 /mm), so K s^2 / 8 = 1.2e-8 m (s = 2.5 um at 48 samples on 1.9 mm): 5e-4 px at 128 px, 2e-3 px at 512 px; a least it hides reaches the cell by at most that, whose share of the sub-cell is at most (0.002 / 0.25)^2 = 6e-5 of a sub-cell: under 4e-6 of a pixel, below every other term. It is not added to the flag; it holds where the sign function is smooth (the helix's turn guess folds only far from its zero level, round 3's 2311 at 9.7 px), and a least beyond the window's 7 spacings is the guard's to find (whole march)
gate_round4_flag.false_alarm_rate: measured as gate_round4_improvement's after (ii): the flagged clean draws whose largest is within the line, of 200 a case

gate_round4_flag.if_wrong: a draw on which the control flags nothing says the flag cannot see a reading the verification cannot mend there; control_past above zero says the bound fails
